review_scope: Full-body architectural review; no clinical certification; excludes all prior 1673 reviewed IDs.

reviews.title: Pediatric Surgeon Profile
reviews.body:
# Pediatric Surgeon Profile

Professional profile of licensed pediatric surgeons.

Supports

• Qualifications

• Experience

• Surgical Specialization

• Languages

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Qualifications, experience, specialization and languages remain separately sourced practitioner-role facts; a profile is not credential verification, active licensure or surgical privilege approval.

reviews.title: Pediatric Surgery Center Profile
reviews.body:
# Pediatric Surgery Center Profile

Stores pediatric surgery center information.

Supports

• Operating Rooms

• ICU

• Physicians

• Contact Information

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Operating rooms, ICU, physicians and contacts are facility capability claims with source and validity; listing an ICU does not prove present staffing, bed availability or pediatric anesthesia coverage.

reviews.title: Pediatric Surgery Appointment Booking
reviews.body:
# Pediatric Surgery Appointment Booking

Allows scheduling surgical consultations.

Supports

• Clinic

• Surgeon

• Telemedicine

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Clinic, surgeon and telemedicine booking require appointment ownership comparison; a reserved slot does not establish surgical indication, guardian consent or emergency access.

reviews.title: Pediatric Surgical Procedure Registry
reviews.body:
# Pediatric Surgical Procedure Registry

Stores all pediatric surgical procedures.

Supports

• Procedure Type

• Date

• Surgeon

• Outcome

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Pediatric surgical workflow preserves procedure, provider, imaging, histology, infection, device and recovery provenance. Booking is not authorization for surgery; professional credentials and facility capability require source verification. Indications, anesthesia plans and complication response remain attributable clinical decisions.
